{{Quote|There are many different Tusken tribes. Since the oceans dried, we have stayed hidden. Other tribes have survived by killing.|translated=1|The chieftain to Boba Fett|<ref name="Chapter 2">{{BOBF|Chapter 2: The Tribes of Tatooine}}</ref>}}
The '''Tusken Chieftain''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Tusken Raider]] who was the [[chief]]tain of a [[Unidentified Tusken Raider tribe|tribe]] of [[Tusken Raider]]s.

==History==
[[File:Hasbro-TuskenTribe.png|thumb|left|350px|The chieftain led a tribe of Tusken Raiders]]
A [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Chapter 1 audio description" /> [[Tusken Raider]] lived on<ref name="Chapter 1" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories]] [[planet]]<ref name="Episode I">{{Film|I}}</ref> [[Tatooine]], where<ref name="Chapter 1" /> he<ref name="RAF2023" /> served as [[chief]]tain of a [[Unidentified Tusken Raider tribe|Tusken tribe]]. The chief's tribe captured the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]] after his escape from the [[sarlacc]] in the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]]. After Fett killed a [[sand beast]], he proved himself to the chief, who accepted him to the tribe, and gave him a [[black melon]] to drink.<ref name="Chapter 1" />

Accepted by the tribe, a [[Tusken warrior|warrior]] instructed Fett how to fight with a [[gaderffii stick]]. Shortly after a training session, the tribe was attacked by blaster bolts from a [[Tatooine repulsor train]], killing several Tusken Raiders and [[bantha]]s. After burning the fallen Tukens, Fett approached the chieftain and the warrior. Communicating in [[Tusken Sign Language]], Fett announced that he will stop the train, and the chieftain replied that he cannot. Fett insisted, saying he will take rifle and stick, and will be back by morning. The chieftain allowed it despite his doubts, and Fett walked during the night to [[Tosche Station]], attacked members of the [[Kintan Striders Gang]], and returned to the [[Tusken Raider camp (Boba Fett)|camp]] with their [[speeder bike]]s. Fett told the chieftain it was a gift, and explained that he will teach them how to ride the speeders, so that they could stop the train. The chieftain left in silence, allowing Fett to teach the tribe.<ref name="Chapter 2" />

Fett instructed the tribe. Eventually, when they were attacked again, Fett led a [[Raid on a Pyke repulsortrain|raid]] on the train, which was operated by the [[Pyke Syndicate]]. Fett and the tribe defeated the [[Pyke]]s and stopped the train. Fett demanded that the Pykes will stop killing Tuskens and pay a toll for traveling on their land. The chieftain arrived to the train and nodded to Fett, appreciating his assistance to the tribe. Later that night, the chieftain explained the history of the tribe, and how the tribe stayed hidden while other tribes survived by killing. Fett replied that they are warriors and should not hide. The chieftain replied that the off-worlders have machines, and Fett affirmed that they have machines now too, and they know every grain of sand in the [[Dune Sea]].<ref name="Chapter 2" />

[[File:Poster-ChiefandBoba.png|thumb|right|300px|The chieftain accepted the human Boba Fett into his tribe and culture.]]
The chieftain presented a gift to Fett, saying it will guide him after Fett was a good guide to the Tribe. The gift turned out to be a [[Horned gekko|gekko]] that crawled inside Fett's body, giving him a vision and making him walk in the desert, until he came across a [[Wortwood tree|wortwood]] [[tree]], from which he broke a [[Wood|branch]]. Fett returned to the camp in the morning, and the chieftain requested to show him the branch, which Fett did. The chieftain nodded in approval and walked away. The other tribe members helped Fett get dressed in black Tusken robes and to forge his own [[Boba Fett's gaderffii stick|gaderffii stick]] in a [[gaderffii stick workshop]]. After his induction, the tribe danced around a campfire.<ref name="Chapter 2" />

After the newly-initiated Boba Fett left to see the Pyke Syndicate in [[Mos Eisley]], the Pykes [[Massacre of a Tusken Raider tribe|massacred]] the tribe, including the chieftain. They painted the symbol of a speeder bike gang known as the Kintan Striders to put the blame on them.<ref name="Chapter 7">{{BOBF|Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor}}</ref> Per Tusken tradition,<ref name="Chapter 2" /> Fett gathered all the bodies and weapons and burned them at a funeral pyre.<ref name="Chapter 3">{{BOBF|Chapter 3: The Streets of Mos Espa}}</ref> Fett later [[Attack on the Kintan Striders|attacked]] the Kintan Striders, killing several of their members, in revenge.<ref name="Chapter 4">{{BOBF|Chapter 4: The Gathering Storm}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Tusken chieftain appeared in the [[Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land|premiere]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'', which aired on [[Disney+]]<ref name="Chapter 1" /> on [[December 29]], [[2021]].<ref name="Disney+">{{DisneyPlusYouTube|t9Ca4ARSfqA|Next On Disney+ | December 2021}}</ref> He was played by [[Xavier Jimenez]].<ref name="Chapter 1" /> ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' mistakenly lists the Tusken Chieftan as a [[human]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref>
